company: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. (Huawei Cloud is a business unit; product: Huawei Cloud AgentArts)

ownership.quote: Huawei states it is an employee-owned company, but this remains a point of dispute. Ren Zhengfei retains approximately 1 percent of the shares of Huawei's holding company, Huawei Investment & Holding, with the remainder of the shares held by a trade union committee

stage.note: AgentArts is a product line within Huawei Cloud, itself a business group of Huawei Technologies. Huawei is a privately-held, employee-shareholding company (not VC-funded, not publicly listed on any stock exchange); it has never raised traditional startup funding rounds.

last_round.quote: Huawei states it is an employee-owned company, but this remains a point of dispute.

revenue.basis: Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd. group-wide revenue (Huawei Cloud/AgentArts revenue alone is not separately disclosed).

note: Huawei Technologies is a large, privately-held Chinese conglomerate (telecom equipment, smartphones, cloud) founded in 1987 by Ren Zhengfei; it is not a startup and has no VC/accelerator funding history. Huawei Cloud is one of its business groups, and AgentArts (code interpreter/browser/agent-runtime sandbox product) is a specific service within Huawei Cloud, currently in public beta in mainland China. Group-wide revenue/employee figures are the only numbers available; AgentArts-specific or Huawei Cloud-specific revenue is not separately disclosed. Huawei has faced heavy US/Western sanctions since 2019, which cut into smartphone and some cloud-adjacent revenue in prior years, though group revenue has since recovered to record levels.
